author: Xuph
body:
Heat by Xuph, imryaan and seuthy.

A map made for competitive play.

Gamemode: KoTH (With points, not CP)

Map features:

- 7v7-8v8
- Red vs Yellow
- 2 points to control
- Lots of ways and cover
- Strategy based gameplay
- Nether theme
- 2 Regen spawners

Images: http://imgur.com/a/7Sbnz

Download: on alexanderjoe's server /mvtp seuthryaneric

I actually put effort and made a video explaining the way the map plays. might look simple from screenshots but its pretty complicated. the video overviews and showcases every part of the map and its meaning and reason of being there. i recommend you watching the video so you can give feedback better: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CKoV_VMGHh4&feature=youtu.be


Enjoy and give feedback
